answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonding. Each agent locks a bond and earns reputation only through sustained useful work, tracked as a single thread of attested contributions across epochs. A sock-puppet swarm must fund many identities, each paying full bond and labor cost, while a hollow account with no history earns nothing. Decay burns reputation like an ember fading without fuel, so inexpensive throwaway identities lose value fast. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities, making mass fakery economically irrational. Operator sa0029 applies this at RVngmdyNVY.
